_comment: Native ALEX Creator: existing file, formats, period/shift (typed or measured by Detect period) and batch controls, plus configured-period excitation candidates in the right preview pane. Both queues and editable phase candidates use declarative data_table sections.

sections.label: File
sections.description: Path of the TTTR file to convert. Press Enter (or click elsewhere) to load it; a file dropped on the window loads too.

buttons.label: Open…
buttons.description: Choose a TTTR file and preview its folded ALEX phase.

buttons.label: Save as…
buttons.description: Write the converted photon data to a new file; the input is never overwritten. Grey until a file is loaded.

sections.label: Input
sections.description: Force the input container type, or Auto to detect it from the file.

sections.label: Output
sections.description: Container format written when saving (differs from input: transcode).

sections.title: ALEX modulation
sections.description: Alternation period (macro-time units) and phase shift of the ALEX excitation modulation.

sections.label: Period
sections.description: ALEX alternation period (macro-time units) mapped onto micro-time.

sections.label: Shift
sections.description: Phase shift of the ALEX period before the macro-time to micro-time mapping.

buttons.label: Detect period
buttons.description: Measure the alternation period from the loaded photon stream (the two busiest detector groups alternate) and set Period to it; the histogram and excitation regions refold. Grey until a file is loaded.

sections.description: Number of photon events of the loaded file.

sections.title: Batch
sections.description: Convert or merge several files in one run.

sections.label: Mode
descriptions: Fold each input file independently and write one converted output per input file.
Concatenate the input files with continuing macro-time, then fold once and write one merged output.
sections.description: Convert every file to its own ALEX output, or merge them all into one.

buttons.label: Add files…
buttons.description: Queue TTTR files; duplicate paths are ignored.

buttons.label: Folder…
buttons.description: Queue the supported TTTR files of a folder, scanned recursively.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Queue TTTR data from the session database.

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected file from the queue; the file stays on disk. Grey until a row is selected.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Empty the queue without deleting files.

sections.description: The queued files, in the order they are converted or merged. Click a row to select it, Delete removes it, the wheel scrolls.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the file is in.

sections.label: Output folder
sections.description: Convert requires a folder; merge defaults to the folder of the first input.

buttons.label: Run batch
buttons.description: Convert each file or merge the queue using the current period, shift and formats.

sections.name: excitation_regions
sections.title: Excitation regions
sections.description: Neutral phase candidates detected at the configured Period and Shift; review and edit them without filtering exported photons.

sections.label: Detectors
sections.description: Blank uses every routing channel separately. Combine polarization channels as 0,8;1,9;2,10. Every observed channel must belong to one group.

buttons.label: Re-detect
buttons.description: Infer every excitation phase again at the configured Period and Shift. This replaces edited candidate regions; photon conversion stays unchanged.

sections.description: Double-click Start or End to edit a candidate. Start greater than End wraps across phase zero. Review marks your confirmation; it never filters the exported photon stream.

columns.title: Phase
columns.tooltip: Neutral candidate phase; its identity is not an inferred wavelength.

columns.title: Start
columns.tooltip: Inclusive phase start in macro-time units. Double-click to edit.

columns.title: End
columns.tooltip: Exclusive phase end in macro-time units. Start greater than End represents a wrapped region.

columns.title: Evidence
columns.tooltip: Candidate, Edited, or Review transition: a nonconstant emission phase may be switching or heterogeneity rather than another laser.

columns.title: Review
columns.tooltip: Mark after reviewing this candidate. Confirmation does not assert its wavelength or change photon exports.
